catalog.name: Tension and anticipation
catalog.formula: X → limited visibility/unexpected outcome/unresolved situation → Z anticipates resolution
catalog.abstract: Scenes create tension and anticipation through mechanisms like limited visibility, unexpected outcomes, and unresolved situations, leading to a desire for resolution.

catalog.name: cluster-2
catalog.formula: X describes Y (cosmic phenomena, scale, historical significance) → Z feels wonder, awe, or grandeur.
catalog.abstract: Scenes create a sense of wonder, awe, or grandeur through descriptions of scale, cosmic phenomena, or historical significance.

catalog.name: cluster-3
catalog.formula: X faces challenge Y → X uses skill/resourcefulness to overcome Y → Z observes and feels admiration or tension.
catalog.abstract: Scenes demonstrate effort, resourcefulness, or skill in overcoming challenges or achieving goals.

catalog.name: cluster-4
catalog.formula: X notices Y (unpredictable behavior, instability) → X feels discomfort or tension.
catalog.abstract: Scenes create a sense of instability or discomfort through unpredictable or unsettling elements.

catalog.name: cluster-5
catalog.formula: X encounters unexpected element Y → Z feels intrigue or curiosity.
catalog.abstract: Scenes create intrigue or curiosity through unexpected elements or mysterious signals.

catalog.name: cluster-6
catalog.formula: X repeats or varies Y → Z introduces unexpected element → Audience feels surprise or humor.
catalog.abstract: Scenes use repetition, variation, or unexpected connections to create surprise or humor.

catalog.name: cluster-7
catalog.formula: X mentions time/resource constraint → Y feels urgency or pressure.
catalog.abstract: Scenes create a sense of urgency or pressure through time constraints or rapid depletion of resources.

catalog.name: cluster-8
catalog.formula: X uses dialogue/setting to create tension → Y experiences suspense or surprise.
catalog.abstract: Scenes create tension or suspense through dialogue, setting, or unexpected success.

catalog.name: cluster-9
catalog.formula: X compares Y with Z → Audience perceives scale or importance.
catalog.abstract: Scenes evoke a sense of scale or importance through comparisons or measurements.

catalog.name: cluster-10
catalog.formula: X initiates movement/preparation → Y perceives readiness or transition.
catalog.abstract: Scenes create a sense of movement, preparation, or transition.

catalog.name: cluster-11
catalog.formula: X demonstrates vulnerability/risk → Y feels tension or empathy.
catalog.abstract: Scenes create tension through physical vulnerability or risky actions.

catalog.name: cluster-12
catalog.formula: X demonstrates abundance/stability → Y feels secure or reassured.
catalog.abstract: Scenes create a sense of abundance, stability, or security.

catalog.name: cluster-13
catalog.formula: X and Y are compared → Audience perceives contrast or harmony.
catalog.abstract: Scenes highlight differences or similarities to create contrast or harmony.

catalog.name: cluster-14
catalog.formula: X mentions familiar element → Audience recalls personal experience → Audience feels nostalgia or connection.
catalog.abstract: Scenes evoke a sense of nostalgia or connection through familiar elements or personal experiences.

catalog.name: cluster-15
catalog.formula: X shows limitation/imperfect result → Audience relates to X and feels humility.
catalog.abstract: Scenes demonstrate limitations or imperfections to evoke relatability or humility.

catalog.name: cluster-16
catalog.formula: X encounters unexpected signal/anomaly → Audience feels mystery or expectation.
catalog.abstract: Scenes create a sense of mystery or expectation through unexpected signals or anomalies.

catalog.name: cluster-17
catalog.formula: X introduces concept → X uses example/demonstration → Audience understands concept.
catalog.abstract: Scenes illustrate concepts or ideas through practical examples or demonstrations.

catalog.name: cluster-18
catalog.formula: X approaches Y → Audience feels intimacy or focus.
catalog.abstract: Scenes create a sense of intimacy or focus through proximity or detailed observation.
